description: Languages with an ISO 639-3 code and a Wikipedia article in several languages
query: SELECT ?item ?label ?alt ?iso ?links WHERE { ?item wdt:P220 ?iso . ?item rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label) = "en") OPTIONAL { ?item skos:altLabel ?alt . FILTER(LANG(?alt) = "en") } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?links . FILTER(?links >= 20) }

al: General language of the Kingdom of Chile
